name: copilot-credit-journey
title: The GHCP user and the GH admin
description: A fictional GHCP user with headphones sits at a paused laptop after reaching 1,900 credits. The GH admin has glasses, an ID badge, and a policy clipboard. The admin owns budgets and model policy, uses automation for usage checks and team changes, and verifies Luna-only access before approving 100 additional credits. A later approved $20 increase raises the total cap to 4,000. Grace is once per month and temporary increases expire.

personas.label: GHCP user
personas.dialogue:
I hit 1,900 credits.
The task isn't finished.

personas.label: GH admin: budgets + policy
personas.dialogue:
I'll verify Luna-only access,
then approve 100 credits ($1).

checks usage and

notes.text:
Grace is once per month.
If used up, credit use
pauses again.

An approved $20 top-up
restores all approved models.

Next month: 1,900 credits.
Temporary increases expire.
